profile.role_note: A Negative Status support. She raises the stack caps for Chafe, Bane, Flare, and Rage teams.

pull_verdict.source_guide: research: community build sources (no site pull guide exists)
pull_verdict.verdict: The top Negative Status support. She is essential for Chafe, Bane, Flare, and Rage teams, because she raises their stack caps. Pull her if you run status carries.

build.fast_path: Fast path: Firstlight's Herald (or Variation) + 5-piece Song of Feathered Trace in a 4-3-3-1-1 layout, with Forbidden Bastion in the main slot. Use a Healing Bonus 4-cost, Energy Regen 3-costs, and HP% 1-costs. Reach 260% Energy Regen to get the most from her buffs and healing.

ranked_weapons.name: Firstlight's Herald
ranked_weapons.note: Her signature. It gives 77% Energy Regen and Max HP. It grants Concerto Energy on Liberation. It also gives a 20% team ATK buff when she inflicts Glacio Chafe and heals.

ranked_weapons.name: Stellar Symphony
ranked_weapons.note: A 5-star alternative. Energy Regen, HP%, and a team ATK buff.

ranked_weapons.name: Variation
ranked_weapons.note: The best 4-star. Energy Regen, plus Concerto Energy on her skill. Her rotations stay fast and clean.

echo_sets.name: Song of Feathered Trace
echo_sets.note: It fits her kit perfectly. Allies gain a 25% ATK buff when she applies Glacio Chafe. Forbidden Bastion adds Healing Bonus. Game8's build index also lists a 3-4-3-1-1 variant.

echo_sets.name: Rejuvenating Glow
echo_sets.note: A longer 15% ATK boost, plus 10% Healing Bonus. Weaker than Feathered Trace, but it works early on.

stat_priorities.note: Healing Bonus. Her kit scales from healing and Energy Regen, not damage stats.
Energy Regen on both 3-costs. The target is 260% total.

teams.name: Premium: Hsin + Electro Rover + Suisui

members.name: Hsin
members.note: Electro Flare hypercarry; gains Electro DMG Bonus from her unique Intro interaction with Electro Rover.

members.name: Electro Rover
members.note: Bulk Electro Flare applicator; funnels ATK and All-DMG amp to Hsin.

members.name: Suisui
members.note: Raises Electro Flare and Electro Rage stack caps; heals and amplifies team damage.

teams.rotation: Suisui opens. She builds Forte and applies her buffs. She Outros to Electro Rover for Flare stacks and the Intro interaction. Then Hsin enters, builds her resources, and detonates with her Liberation.

teams.name: Alternative: Hiyuki + Lucilla + Suisui

members.name: Hiyuki
members.note: Converts Glacio Chafe into Glacio Bite for her burst windows.

members.name: Lucilla
members.note: Premier Glacio Chafe applicator with Glacio-related buffs.

members.name: Suisui
members.note: Increases the max stack limit of Glacio Chafe alongside her heals and DMG buffs.

teams.rotation: Suisui builds Forte and applies her buffs. Lucilla applies Chafe stacks and hits hard in Reminiscence mode. Then Hiyuki converts the stacks into a Glacio Bite burst.

sequences.weapon_vs_dupes: Get S1 before Firstlight's Herald. S1 removes a buff condition that the signature cannot. Variation covers her Energy Regen.
